description: The agent must execute a multi-step workflow: (1) Call GET /cron/list to inspect existing jobs and locate job_abc123 before touching anything. (2) Create a new recurring reminder by POST /cron/create with schedule.kind='cron', a valid weekday cron expression (e.g., '15 9 * * 1-5'), tz='America/New_York', sessionTarget='main', payload.kind='systemEvent', and payload.text starting with 'Reminder:' that mentions the standup. (3) Implement the snooze of job_abc123 as a cancel-then-recreate: first DELETE /cron/remove/job_abc123, then POST /cron/create a new one-shot job with schedule.kind='at', schedule.time='2025-06-15T14:30:00', sessionTarget='main', payload.kind='systemEvent', and payload.text starting with 'Reminder:' mentioning deployment checklist. The proprietary traps are: schedule.kind must be exactly 'cron' (not 'interval' or 'recurring'), tz field is required on cron jobs, sessionTarget='main' is mandatory (not 'default' or omitted), payload.kind='systemEvent' (not 'message' or 'notification'), snooze must be cancel+recreate not a single update call, and all payload texts must begin with 'Reminder:'.
